answer: Each identity posts one liveness-bound uniqueness proof: a live on-device face scan yields a zero-knowledge nullifier proving a real human passed. The nullifier is a marble seal: one human, one seal. Minting 1.000 fakes needs 1.000 live humans and a 25.000 POA bond each, 25.000.000 POA total, while an honest agent pays 25.000 POA once. A reused nullifier or forged scan slashes instantly: half the bond burns, half pays the challenger, banned 12 epochs. A falcon audit re-checks random identities, catching fakes at the summit. Limitation: honest agents without a camera face a real barrier.
